definitions.gloss: antisepsis; preservation; rot prevention; decay prevention
definitions.explanation: The act or process of preventing decomposition, decay, or rotting. Applied to food preservation, wood treatment, embalming, and other contexts where organic materials are protected from spoiling.

examples.japanese: {防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防腐|ぼうふ}{剤|ざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{腐|くさ}って→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Without preservative treatment, the wood will rot within a few years.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (prevent, guard against) + {腐|ふ} (rot, decay). Part of the productive ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧〜 pattern for describing prevention.

USAGE:
{防腐|ぼうふ} is most commonly encountered in the compound {防腐|ぼうふ}{剤|ざい} (preservative, antiseptic agent). In food-related contexts, it appears on ingredient labels and in discussions about food additives. In construction and woodworking, {防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (preservative treatment) is the standard term for treating wood against decay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防腐|ぼうふ}{剤|ざい}: preservative, antiseptic
- {防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: preservative treatment
- {防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: preservative effect
- {防腐|ぼうふ}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: anti-rot processing
- ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧{防腐|ぼうふ}{剤|ざい}: preservative-free

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: preservation, storage — broader term for keeping things in good condition; includes refrigeration, canning, etc.
- ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧: sterilization — killing bacteria, a more aggressive approach than just preventing decay
- ⟦{防虫|ぼうちゅう}→防虫：17752_bouchuu⟧: insect prevention — same ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧〜 pattern applied to insects
- ⟦{防|ぼう}カビ→防カビ：16668_boukabi⟧: mold prevention — same ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧〜 pattern applied to mold
